ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   D. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   B. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   C. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

10. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   B. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
   D. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Obligations of Children to Parents and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Children’s obligation to other family members 03 7 Islamic Heritage and Civilisa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Call to prophet hood 03 7.2 Earliest coverts to Islam 04 7.3 Prophets journey Ta and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. D — Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. B — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Obligations of Children to Parents; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Children’s Obligations to Other Family Members; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Call to prophet hood 03 7.2 Earliest coverts to Islam 04 7.3 Prophets journey Ta; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
